text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty -> P2: canary error spike after release v3.14.2. Affected service: inference-proxy. Root: suspicious image tag swap in registry. Please ack.

Sara (SRE): acked — I'm on it. Can someone post the canary logs?

mike (releases): saw alerts 02:13 UTC, CPU and 5xxs jumped on canary hosts. I rolled traffic back at LB level briefly but errors persisted. Noted registry push earlier at 01:58 from ci-builder.

olivia (eng): grabbing canary host logs now. Reproducer shows model container failing to load kv-store due to unexpected file layout.

kevin (devops): looking at registry. gcr repo shows two tags for sha: earlier tag v3.14.2 pointed to digest sha256:AAA111 but now v3.14.2 -> sha256:BBB222 (retag). This smells like mutable tag / cache poisoning.

mike (releases): that's the problem. CI must not retag. paging build owner. deploy-bot: show deploy summary.

deploy-bot: Deployed: inference-proxy:v3.14.2 -> hosts canary-{a,b,c}. Start: 2023-05-03T01:59:32Z. Status: succeeded.

Sara (SRE): quick impact check — which endpoints? inference-proxy routes: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings. Metrics: canary served ~4% of traffic. Errors concentrated on downstream model load -> 502s for generation. Approx 2.3k requests failed in last 10m.

mike (releases): customer-facing impact: internal logs show 1% of production traffic hit canary region and some customers saw increased latency; no widespread outage but degrading quality for a subset of requests (mobile clients in us-west). Flagging for incident.

Sara (SRE): mitigation plan: 1) kill feature flag to stop canary routing -> roll traffic back to previous stable. 2) mark v3.14.2 tag immutable (if possible) and force-regenerate correct image digest. 3) rollback canary hosts to earlier image by digest. I need a steward for registry ops.

kevin (devops): I can do registry ops. First I want to capture evidence. Running:
```
# list tags for repo
gcloud container images list-tags gcr.io/redwood/inference-proxy --limit=50 --sort-by=TIMESTAMP
# inspect digest
gcloud container images describe gcr.io/redwood/inference-proxy@sha256:BBB222
```

olivia (eng): log snippet from canary container:
```
E052 02:02:11 model_loader.cpp:74] KV store path invalid: expected /opt/model/kv.bin, found /tmp/kv_cache_v2
E052 02:02:11 startup: Model failed to initialize, exiting(1)
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/server.py", line 213, in main
    model = Model.load(config.path)
OSError: Cannot open kv store
```

mike (releases): we need an immediate kill-switch. Who owns the feature flag? @olivia?

olivia (eng): I can toggle. Flipper flag is `routes.canary_inference`. Toggling now.

olivia (eng): toggled routes.canary_inference -> off :white_check_mark:. Canary traffic drained, LB confirmed to route 0% to canary within 30s.

oncall-bot: :white_check_mark: Feature flag toggled by olivia (eng). Canary traffic -> 0%. Monitoring for error rate to drop.

Sara (SRE): errors dropping on metrics dashboard. 502 rate back to baseline in ~90s. Great. Next: rollback artifact state and lock tag. Kevin, can you prevent further retagging?

kevin (devops): locking strategy: set tag immutability or create policy to reject non-ci pushes for prod tags. For immediate fix I'll re-push the correct digest and update tag via signed operation. Steps:
1) find correct digest: sha256:AAA111 (last good).
2) reassign v3.14.2 -> AAA111 with signed note.
3) set registry policy / webhook to reject future manual retags.

uknown-user (pagerduty-bot): Incident created INC-2026-1234. Severity: P2. Assigned to eng-oncall.

mike (releases): produce postmortem checklist: how did tag get swapped? check CI pipeline job `ci/publish-image` logs. Also confirm no rollouts used mutable latest tags.

kevin (devops): evidence: CI logs show a manual re-tag job at 01:56 by user `jdoe-ci` with command `gcloud container images add-tag gcr.io/redwood/inference-proxy@sha256:BBB222 gcr.io/redwood/inference-proxy:v3.14.2` (no approval step). I'll snapshot logs.

Sara (SRE): rolling back canary nodes to digest AAA111 to be safe. Command:
```
kubectl set image deploy/inference-proxy inference-proxy=gcr.io/redwood/inference-proxy@sha256:AAA111 -n canary
kubectl rollout status deploy/inference-proxy -n canary
```

olivia (eng): running rollback now. Watching pods.

olivia (eng): pods are coming up on AAA111, liveness checks passing.

oncall-bot: :white_check_mark: Rollback complete on canary. Observability indicates stable error/latency.

Sara (SRE): customer impact summary for postmortem: ~2.3k failed requests, ~4% canary traffic, visible to small subset of customers in us-west for ~5m window. No data exfiltration, no other services impacted.

mike (releases): next steps (owner):
- kevin (devops): implement tag immutability + CI webhook (owner)
- sara (SRE): add runbook entry for mutable-tag canary detection (owner)
- olivia (eng): add image digest pinning enforcement in deployment manifests (owner)
- mike (releases): follow up with CI team and disable manual retagging for prod tags (owner)

kevin (devops): I'll start on webhook today. ETA 24h for initial guard, 72h for registry policy.

Sara (SRE): I'm preparing initial incident notes and will hand off to oncall-night. @mike please assign to next rotation.

mike (releases): assigning handoff — pinging @oncall-night. Handing off at ts 2313000265. All actions noted in INC-2026-1234.

oncall-bot: Handoff recorded. Next on-call: alice-night (SRE).

alice-night (SRE): acked — I'll pickup monitoring and confirm the webhook progress tomorrow morning.

mike (releases): summary: root cause = manual mutable tag retag to wrong digest during CI maintenance, caused canary to run mismatched image with file layout change -> model fails -> 502s. Mitigations applied: feature flag kill, canary rollback, tag lock plan. Postmortem owners assigned.

Sara (SRE): adding note: include detection rule: alert when canary error rate > 1.5x baseline within 5m and correlate with image digest change events in registry audit logs.

olivia (eng): thumbs up. Good work everyone. :raised_hands:

kevin (devops): leaving logs and commands in INC-2026-1234. Will follow up with PR to CI to ban `gcloud add-tag` without approval.

mike (releases): closing thread for now — continue discussion in the incident doc. :lock:
